# Niels Bilenberg

Niels Bilenberg is a senior physician (overlæge) and PhD affiliated with the department of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatri) in Odense, part of the university function of Psychiatry in the Region of Southern Denmark (Psykiatrien i Region Syddanmark) [^src1]. He is named as the representative for [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] on the steering group (styregruppen) of the Danish ADHD database, a national health register that monitors the quality of diagnosis and treatment of ADHD among children and adolescents under 18 [^src1][^src2].

His inclusion places him among a group of overlæger, speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, epidemiologer, and pårørenderepræsentanter from across Denmark who oversee the database, which tracks children and young people assessed or treated for ADHD in the period 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024, and which has documented findings such as significantly lower rates of children with ADHD passing the folkeskole leaving exam before age 17 compared to the general population [^src2]. Beyond his listed role and regional representation, no further biographical or professional details are provided in the source material.
